}}'''Muhammad Rasul Jan''' is a Pakistani chemist in the field of [[analytical chemistry]]. He served as Vice-Chancellor of [[University of Malakand]] from 14 April 2008 till 1 October 2012. He also served as Vice-Chancellor at [[University of Peshawar]] and currently he is serving as Vice-Chancellor at the [[University of Poonch]] in Rawalakot, [[Azad Kashmir]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.upesh.edu.pk//messages/?q=vice-chancellor |title=VICE CHANCELLOR &#124; University of Peshawar |website=www.upesh.edu.pk |access-date=14 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130402065239/http://www.upesh.edu.pk//messages/?q=vice-chancellor |archive-date=2 April 2013 |url-status=dead}}</ref> He has published extensively in national and international journals and has supervised many M.Phil. and PhD scholars in the field of Analytical Chemistry.

==Education and life==
Jan was born in the village of [[Ningolai]] in [[Kabal, Tehsil|Kabal]] of [[Swat District]], [[Pakistan]] and studied [[chemistry]] at the [[University of Peshawar]], obtaining an [[Master of Philosophy|M.Phil]]. Dr.Jan obtained his PhD from [[University College Cork]], followed by three years [[Postdoctoral research|Post-Doctoral work]] in the [[University College Dublin]], in the Republic of Ireland. Returning to Pakistan in 1985, he joined the Department of Chemistry at the University of Peshawar as assistant professor. In 1999 he was appointed as head of the Department of Environmental Sciences. He held a [[Fulbright Program]] fellowship at the [[New Mexico State University]] in 2003. He worked in Bio-Design institute at [[Arizona State University]], United States.
He was awarded [[Pride of Performance|Pride of Performance (2010)]] and [[Sitara-e-Imtiaz|Sitara-e-Imtiaz (2016)]] in Science by the president of [[Pakistan|Islamic Republic of Pakistan]].
